# Apex Engineering Group

> Professional CAD modeling, SolidWorks design, ANSYS FEA structural analysis, and CFD simulation services for manufacturing, R&D, aerospace, oil & gas, and HVAC industries.

Apex Engineering Group is an engineering consultancy run by Asadullah Anis offering end-to-end product design, simulation, and optimization. We deliver production-ready CAD assemblies, manufacturing drawings, and detailed FEA/CFD reports for engineers, manufacturers, and startups worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, portfolio highlights, pricing, and contact.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Full project gallery filterable by industry (Aerospace, Oil & Gas, HVAC, Manufacturing).
- [CAD Projects](/cad-projects): SolidWorks modeling, assembly design, and manufacturing drawings.
- [Analysis Projects](/analysis-projects): FEA stress analysis, CFD flow simulation, and thermal studies.

## Services

- CAD Modeling & SolidWorks Design
- ANSYS Structural FEA
- CFD Flow & Thermal Analysis
- Product Design & Optimization
- Manufacturing Drawings (PDF/DXF)
